violations.text: Chicken was observed thawing in stagnant water (3 bay sink area). Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Correct By: 10/19/2026
